headline: Order ends special U.S. legal protections for the Development Fund for Iraq and certain other Iraqi property.
what_it_does: An earlier order, Executive Order 13303, gave the Development Fund for Iraq and certain other Iraqi property in the United States protection from some legal actions, such as being seized to pay court judgments. This order ends those protections. Only the title was available, so details such as which property is covered and any exceptions are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Its fund and certain property in the U.S. no longer have the special legal protections granted by the earlier order.

who_it_affects.group: People and companies with legal claims against Iraq
who_it_affects.how: Their ability to take legal action involving the covered Iraqi property may change because the protections that blocked such actions are ended.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 27, 2014; the title does not state a separate effective date.
